title: Card on File and the Home Delivery Pharmacy Down-Payment Rate
content:
## Payment methods notice: cards on file

**Notice.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, the down-payment rate is reduced for a card on file backed by card payments in the card review window: by 3 points when a credit, debit or HSA/FSA card is on file and six or more payments by such cards posted in the window, by 1 point when a card is on file and one to five such payments posted in the window, and not at all in every other case.

"On file" is the payment method recorded on the home delivery account; the payments counted are member payments made by credit card, debit card or HSA/FSA card and posted within the card review window. A point is one percentage point of the down-payment rate.

### Reduction table

| Card on file | Card payments posted in the window | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 6 or more | 3 points |
| Yes | 1 to 5 | 1 point |
| Yes | none | none |
| No | any | none |

### Hypothetical cases

- Debit card on file, seven debit card payments in the window: 3 points.
- Credit card on file, five payments in the window (three by credit card, two by HSA/FSA card): 1 point.
- No card on file, eight card payments in the window: none.
